# Document reader fixtures

`legacy.doc` and `legacy.xls` are synthetic fixtures from [AnyDoc v0.2.4](https://github.com/firecrawl/anydoc/tree/v0.2.4/tests/fixtures), originally `doc/text.doc` and `xls/sheet.xls`. The accompanying MIT license applies to these files.

`chinese-mixed.pdf` was generated for this project. Page 1 has selectable Chinese text in STSong-Light with a CID font encoding. Page 2 contains only a raster image with the text `SCANNED RECEIPT 2468`.
